emily_mobile: Weird edge-case hit in the sample app: WorkManager worker uses Retrofit.enqueue() -> Authenticator does a coroutine refresh -> we get duplicate refreshes and multiple 401 retries when device is dozing. Repro on Pixel 8 emulator but suspect wider.

omar_sdk: Can you paste the minimal repro steps and logs?

emily_mobile: Steps: app backgrounded, periodic WorkManager sync runs, worker calls service.sync().enqueue(...). If token expired, authenticator triggers refresh; logs show multiple `refresh started` entries and a flood of retries.

emily_mobile: Log excerpt:
```
I/Auth: refresh started (ctx=worker-12)
I/Network: 401 for /v1/sync (req=1)
I/Auth: refresh started (ctx=worker-13)
W/OkHttp: connection reuse failed
I/Network: retrying request (req=2)
```

nina_qe: Sounds like enqueue() not propagating cancellation/ordering, so your in-memory guard races. Are you persisting tokens?

emily_mobile: We had an in-memory cache + `var refreshInProgress = false` guarded by synchronized block. When coroutines get cancelled or workers run concurrently, the guard fails and multiple refreshes run. Token persisted in DataStore in some codepaths but not consistently.

omar_sdk: Two recommended patterns: (1) Use a coroutine-aware Call.await() adapter that cancels underlying Call when coroutine cancels, and then `withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { service.sync().await() }` in workers so cancellation semantics align. (2) Implement Authenticator single-flight using AtomicReference<CompletableDeferred<Token>> or Mutex + persistent token store so background tasks see updated token.

rolf_infra: Also tune OkHttp Dispatcher and timeouts for mobile WorkManager bursts. Example: Dispatcher(maxRequests=6, maxRequestsPerHost=2), callTimeout=60s, connectTimeout=10s. Shorter connectionPool.keepAlive(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS) helped in emulator doze tests.

emily_mobile: I tried two things: moved worker to suspending await() variant and implemented AtomicReference single-flight. That stopped concurrent refreshes but on older low-end devices refresh blocking stalls other tasks.

omar_sdk: If blocking refresh stalls threads, prefer single-flight that performs refresh asynchronously but returns a CompletableDeferred that callers await; tie lifecycle to persisted cache so once refresh finishes, other workers reread token immediately. Important: Authenticator is invoked synchronously on OkHttp threads, so heavy suspending work there can be problematic unless you offload properly.

nina_qe: For CI/coverage we should add a tiny emulator test: run background workers with device doze toggles + network flaps to catch regressions. I can add that to the samples matrix.

emily_mobile: Pushed minimal repro under `android/samples/workmanager-auth-race-v2` with 1) enqueue-based worker repro, 2) suspending-await variant, 3) AtomicReference single-flight snippet. CI flagged the sample build.

ci-bot: CI: samples/workmanager-auth-race-v2 build queued (job #9072).

rolf_infra: Also document this in devex: short note titled "WorkManager + OkHttp: avoid enqueue() in background workers; Authenticator single-flight patterns" includes Call.await adapter, AtomicReference<CompletableDeferred> example, and recommended dispatcher/timeouts.

emily_mobile: Thanks all. Would appreciate a quick review of the single-flight snippet before I open the PR.

omar_sdk: Will review today. Also add a warning in onboarding about legacy workers that still use enqueue().
